findings.oracle: Real bridge.pipe_close coroutine raises OSError('access denied') and flows through the real BridgeCallWorker QThread + persistent asyncio loop (no patched dispatcher); independent oracle = the genuine 'Close Pipe Error' QMessageBox the recorder captures; asserts calls==[((0xABC,),{})], messages==['\\.\pipe\TestPipe: access denied'], row count==1 and handle map preserved after the real failure.

Real pipe_close coroutine resolves True through the real worker; oracle = observable table row removal pumped via the real Qt loop; asserts row count==0, calls==[((0xABC,),{})] and the handle key is gone only after the authentic success callback runs.

Real get_job_info coroutine returns {'active_processes':2,'total_page_file_usage':4096}; oracle = exact tree (field,value) pairs after two real dispatches; asserts pairs==[('active_processes','2'),('total_page_file_usage','4096')] exactly once (clear-before-populate) and calls==[((1234,),{}),((1234,),{})].

No dispatcher patch; _RecordingAsyncMethod records real invocations; with _attached_pid None asserts get_token_privileges.calls==[] while the companion attached test proves the same real path DOES fire with pid 4321 and renders exact rows, so the empty-calls assertion is a live gate not a dead path.
Real recording bridge method, no patched runner; asserts adjust_token_privilege.calls==[] when unattached; gate proven live by the attached-path dispatch coverage in the same suite.
Real recording list_services method; asserts calls==[] when _attached_pid is None; the services error test confirms the same real method DOES reach the worker when attached.
